Failure Scenario: Failure of 1 TMS Central Control Unit (CCU)
Guidelines for the Chief Controller:
• Train Entering service: Not allowed to enter service
• Train already in service: Exit at Terminus Station
Local Response: Reset CCU

Failure Scenario: Failure of 2 TMS Central Control Unit (CCU)
Guidelines for the Chief Controller:
• Train Entering service: Not allowed to enter service
• Train already in service: Immediate Train Withdrawal from service
• Note: Rescue Train may be required
Local Response: Reset CCU. If not success, train need to be couple

Failure Scenario: Failure of Single Multifunction Vehicle Bus (MVB) Network
Guidelines for the Chief Controller:
• Train Entering service: Not allowed to enter service
•Train already in service: Immediate Train Withdrawal from service
•Note: Rescue Train may be required
Local Response: Check on HMI and identify which equipment causing alarm appear and reset if possible

Failure Scenario: Failure of Double Multifunction Vehicle Bus (MVB) Network

Failure Scenario: Loss of DC Power by Train
ATS Alarm Description: 1st alarm appear Loss of traction energy and 3AC power supply faulty 2nd alarm appear (Normally after 1 hour) Low voltage battery (Loss of DC voltage)

• Train Entering service: Not allowed to enter service
• Train already in service: Immediate Train Withdrawal from service

• Train Entering service: Not allowed to enter service

• Note: Deploy qualified Train driver to verify the fault at the next station upon receiving the alarm

ii. Both APS Failure- Reset APS.If unsuccesful, immediate train removal.

Local Response:
i. TO to verify the alarm at HMI, disembark passenger at station and train move to pocket track or nearest exit station.

 ii.TO and SO shall advise passenger waiting at the platform to board the next coming train.

Failure Scenario: Degraded Performance of Train Emergency Brakes Caused by Safety Loop fault
Guidelines for the Chief Controller:
• Train Entering service: Not allowed to enter service
• Train already in service: Immediate Train Withdrawal from service.
• Note: if Safety Loop can be reset keep Train in service and Remove at Terminus station
Local Response:
•Resettable: Driving in RM/CM to the 
nearest stabling location.
•Non Resettable: Activate Safety Loop 
Bypass by follow Safety loop bypass 
procedure

•Train Entering service: Not allowed to enter service

• Note:
1. Rescue Train may be required
2. Train will moving slower (45kph)
Local Response: Isolate the defective brake

Failure Scenario: Train Brakes Not Released Causing Train Unable to Move

Local Response: Isolate the defective brake

Failure Scenario: Train Brakes Not Released and Train is Able to Move with 5km/h

 8.5 – 10.5 bar (Operating condition for MRE Pressure)

Failure Scenario: Noise & Vibration level acceptable
Guidelines for the Chief Controller:
• Train  Entering  service:  Not   allowed  to  enter service.
•Train   already   in   service:   Removal   at   Exit Terminus station
Local Response: If  the  noise  level  is  acceptable,  continue service until the end of mission and schedule for maintenance.

Failure Scenario: Noise & Vibration level not acceptable
Guidelines for the Chief Controller:
• Train Entering service: Not allowed to enter service
•Train already in service:  Exit at Terminus station
Local Response:
Require  field  staff  to  on  board  train  during removal at terminus station
Qualified train driver to report and clarify the condition,  subject  to  condition  to  remove train.  If  the  vibration  level  is  acceptable, continue service until the end of mission and schedule for maintenance. If qualified train driver  or  passengers  report  the  vibration level     is     unacceptable     and     causing discomfort or disturbance, withdraw the train from service immediately

Failure Scenario: First Time
Guidelines for the Chief Controller:
•Train Entering service: Not allowed to enter service.
• Train already in service:  if rollback is detected for the first time, continue with normal service and OCC monitors Train for further rollback event

Failure Scenario: More than once (More than 3)
Guidelines for the Chief Controller:
• Train Entering service:(Not) allowed to enter service.
• Train already in service:Immediate Train Withdrawal from the service.
• Note: if rollback detection is repetitive for the same Train, withdraw the Train from service
Local Response:
Field staff require to onboard train for 
contingency.

• Train Entering service: Not allowed to enter service.
•Train already in service:  N/A

Failure Scenario: Train sleep at mainline more than 2 times and able to wake up

Qualify train driver staff need to drive in CM, 
if not possible drive RM, if not possible drive 
in Cut Out mode. Rescue require (couple by Loco/ET)

Note: 
i. Monitor whether the train experiences slip/slide at the same section of the track. If yes, schedule maintenance staff to assess adhesion condition of track.
 ii. If it is decided the train is experiencing slip/slide issues, schedule the train for maintenance
 iii. If noise/vibration level is unacceptable, disembark passengers and withdraw the train from service at the next station

Equipment: All train doors at APG side not open

Failure Scenario: Regional Train Operation
Guidelines for the Chief Controller:
i. Verify offline status by maintenance team and TO
ii. Send remote reset command to restart Trackside ATO
iii. If restoration is in time before stopping, the current operating mode will be retained.
Local Response:
i. Maintenance team standby at all ILC station and switch machine.
ii. TO manual driving all trains

Failure Scenario: Radio network connection
Guidelines for the Chief Controller:
i. Reset command and/or remote reset WNRA by maintenance team.
ii. If restoration is in time before stopping, the current operating mode will be retained.
Local Response: Hard Reset WNRA by maintenance team.

Failure Scenario: Centralized train supervision
Guidelines for the Chief Controller:
i. Reboot ATS by Maintenance Team.
ii. If restoration is in time before stopping, the current operating mode will be retained.
Local Response:
i. Maintenance team standby at all ILC station or impacted stations.
ii. Operation to regulate train movement and monitor using ILC

Failure Scenario: Switch machine controller
ATS Alarm Description: Switch out of Control and switch out of correspondence
Guidelines for the Chief Controller:
i. To verify failure through CFMS
ii. Deploy maintenance team to troubleshoot switch machine and related equipment
iii. Impact service delay, restore to normal peration.
Local Response: Send maintenance team with appropriate protection to fix Switch Machine onsite and related equipment

Failure Scenario: Breaker failed to closed
Guidelines for the Chief Controller:
i. Bypass dedicated feeder breaker and feeder isolator.
ii. Closed on-load isolator 89L21 / 89L31.
Local Response:
Maintenance technician to verify condition breaker at site: 
i. Reset breaker and inform OCC to normalize. 
ii. Unable to reset, remain bypass and to be attend during EP hour.
